fsm_states_transaction.name: IDLE
fsm_states_transaction.description: CS# high; bus idle; clock may be stopped; HyperRAM continues self-refresh.

fsm_states_transaction.name: CA_PHASE
fsm_states_transaction.description: CS# low; host drives the 48-bit Command-Address on DQ[7:0] over three clocks (six DDR bytes).

fsm_states_transaction.name: LATENCY
fsm_states_transaction.description: Device inserts the configured initial latency (3..7 clocks); in variable-latency mode RWDS during CA selected 1x or 2x.

fsm_states_transaction.name: READ_DATA
fsm_states_transaction.description: Memory drives DDR read data on DQ[7:0] with RWDS as the edge-aligned read strobe.

fsm_states_transaction.name: WRITE_DATA
fsm_states_transaction.description: Host drives DDR write data on DQ[7:0] with RWDS as the byte data mask.

fsm_states_transaction.name: END
fsm_states_transaction.description: CS# high deasserts and ends the transaction; return to IDLE.

fsm_states_power.name: ACTIVE
fsm_states_power.description: A transaction is in progress (CS# low).

fsm_states_power.name: STANDBY
fsm_states_power.description: CS# high, clock may stop; HyperRAM retains data via self-refresh.

fsm_states_power.name: DEEP_POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_power.description: HyperRAM ultra-low-power state entered via CR0; exit requires a defined wake-up time.

fsm_hints.trigger: CS# falling edge begins CA_PHASE; the 48-bit CA selects read/write and memory/register; after LATENCY the data phase runs until CS# rises.
fsm_hints.rule: In variable-latency mode the host MUST sample RWDS during the CA phase to decide 1x vs 2x latency; in fixed mode latency is always 2x.
fsm_hints.abort: A CS# rising edge at any time ends the transaction immediately.

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up (or after RESET#) the device holds its default configuration (default initial latency, latency model, drive strength, burst length). The host typically reads ID0/ID1, programs CR0/CR1 for the operating frequency, then begins memory transactions.

default_ready_state_recommendation.bus_idle: CS# high; DQ/RWDS released (high-Z); clock may be stopped.
default_ready_state_recommendation.tx_active: Assert CS# low and drive the 48-bit CA, then data on the appropriate edges.
default_ready_state_recommendation.rx_idle: Release DQ/RWDS for the memory to drive read data + strobe.

configurations.name: HyperRAM (self-refresh PSRAM)
configurations.description: Variable latency hides refresh collisions; deep power down via CR0.

configurations.name: HyperFlash (NOR flash)
configurations.description: Same CA/latency/DDR read flow; NOR program/erase command sequences.

timing_dependency_rule: All command, address, and data are referenced to CK edges (double data rate). Read capture is referenced to the memory-driven RWDS strobe. The initial latency between CA and data is fixed by CR0 (and, in variable mode, by the RWDS level during the CA phase).
